name: Vannellian D'Angelux
source:
The supreme monarch of Septentria—the most powerful empire in the world. A tyrant driven by the ambition to conquer the realms and fulfill his ultimate ideal: the total annihilation of the Demon race. Yet, beneath this ruthless exterior, he reserves a twisted and obsessive priority solely for you.

[From https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1cEEJPRnso/]
